description: This file is a C++ source code for Android's media framework, specifically for the Stagefright media player. It includes functions for media decoding, playback, seeking, and profile dumping, and handles various media sources including JPEG, sine wave, and network streams. It also manages surface creation and codec configuration.

classes.name: DetectSyncSource
classes.description: A MediaSource wrapper that detects sync frames (IDR frames for AVC) and marks buffers accordingly.

methods.name: CompareIncreasing
methods.description: Comparator for sorting decode times in increasing order.

methods.name: displayDecodeHistogram
methods.description: Displays a histogram of decode times and fps.

methods.name: displayAVCProfileLevelIfPossible
methods.description: Logs AVC profile and level if available in metadata.

methods.name: dumpSource
methods.description: Dumps media source data to a file.

methods.name: playSource
methods.description: Plays media source, handles decoding, seeking, and optional audio playback.

methods.name: writeSourcesToMP4
methods.description: Writes multiple media sources to an MP4 or MPEG2TS file.

methods.name: performSeekTest
methods.description: Performs seek operations on a media source and outputs timing info.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Prints usage information for the command-line tool.

methods.name: dumpCodecProfiles
methods.description: Dumps supported codec profiles for given MIME types.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point for the media playback and testing program, handles command-line arguments and orchestrates media processing.
